system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Performance

Your allies are encouraged by your bravery in the face of danger.

When an enemy attack hits you in Melee, you can make a show of how little it affected you (whether the Damage was actually minor or not).

If you do so, allies within visual range of you increase their Melee and Accuracy by +1 until the end of their next turn.

You can only use this Ability once per combat.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.Bk2DytuRLYt6aFll]{Display of Courage}
